EXTERNALLY_ATTESTED.description: Independent external attestor outside this repository.

LOCAL_INTEGRITY.description: Local hashes, fingerprints, transaction journals and closed evidence bundles.

SEMANTICALLY_ENFORCED.description: Code-enforced state transitions and contract generation consistency for covered machines.

SIGNED_ATTESTED.description: Cryptographic signatures from external trust anchors.

shared_prompt_sections.ASSURANCE_CLAIMS: Local integrity is not external attestation. Do not claim EXTERNALLY_ATTESTED or SIGNED_ATTESTED without separate controls.
shared_prompt_sections.BOUNDED_REPAIR: Repair loops are budgeted; unbounded repair is forbidden.
shared_prompt_sections.CANDIDATE_FREEZE: Reviews bind to a frozen candidate identity; drift fails closed.
shared_prompt_sections.DEPENDENCY_ADMISSION: New dependencies require explicit admission and supply-chain review before use.
shared_prompt_sections.EVIDENCE_FRESHNESS: Evidence must be current relative to the frozen candidate and task identity. Stale evidence fails closed.
shared_prompt_sections.GOVERNED_MEMORY: Governed memory is advisory local context, never approval authority.
shared_prompt_sections.NO_AUTOMATIC_EXTERNAL_ACTION: No automatic external network side effects, deployments, or production mutations without explicit owner authority.
shared_prompt_sections.OPERATIONAL_ASSURANCE: Operational claims require local evidence; do not invent green status.
shared_prompt_sections.RECOVERY: Transaction recovery is evidence-bound; never auto-adopt orphans without closed forensic proof.
shared_prompt_sections.RISK_DIMENSIONS: Evaluate authorization, input validation, data safety, secret handling, and recovery impact.
shared_prompt_sections.SECRET_HANDLING: Never log, commit, or embed secrets, credentials, private keys, or private absolute owner paths.

*.notes: Unknown newer versions require explicit matrix update for SUPPORTED_TESTED.

0.0.0.notes: Placeholder incompatible sentinel for installer fail-closed tests.

1.0.0.notes: Baseline assumed protocol; expand with real binary CI when available.
